# Original uploader.jp assets

Downloaded on 2026-10-27. Source references are preserved here; no source scripts or advertisements are executed.

- `bootstrap.min.css`: https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.2/css/bootstrap.min.css
- `fonts/glyphicons-halflings-regular.*`: https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.2/fonts/
- `uploader.css`: https://r.getuploader.com/css/uploader.css
- `rwd-table.min.css`: https://r.getuploader.com/css/rwd-table.min.css
- `favicon.ico`: https://r.getuploader.com/favicon.ico

Bootstrap's font URL prefix was changed from `../fonts/` to `fonts/` for this local directory. The other CSS is preserved as served, including the original media query syntax. Copyright and license comments remain in the original assets. `source-assets.json` records image URLs found in the preserved body markup; this import found none requiring additional copies.
